class.name: SSQBResource
class.description: Holds the sequence binary produced from a SpriteStudio sequence ([code].ssqe[/code]) alongside the animations, either by dropping the project onto the editor (the [b]SS Importer[/b] dock) or by running [code]ssconverter-cli[/code]. A sequence is a playlist that chains animations together. The resource loads and saves today, but no node consumes it yet — sequence playback is not implemented in this version, so loading a [code].ssqb[/code] has no effect on [SpriteStudioPlayer2D]. See [SSABResource] for the animation data that is playable.

method.name: load_from_file
method.description: Replaces the contents of this resource with the [code].ssqb[/code] file at [param path]. Returns [constant OK] on success.

method.name: save_to_file
method.description: Writes the held binary to [param path] unchanged. Returns [constant OK] on success.

members.member: The held binary. Setting it replaces the binary the way [method load_from_file] does. Bytes that are not a usable [code].ssqb[/code] are not kept, and an error is printed. It is a storage property, not shown in the Inspector, so that reloading the resource in place replaces the binary: the editor does that when the file changes on disk, and so does [method ResourceLoader.load] with [constant ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_REPLACE]. Reading it does not copy the bytes.
